title: UCC § 2-206 — offer and acceptance
summary: The assigned text discusses acceptance by a prompt promise to ship or by shipment of conforming or nonconforming goods.
notes: The shipment introduction quotes part of § 2-206(1)(b). The continuation at p. 235 explains how nonconforming shipment can both accept and breach unless sent as an accommodation. The intervening Corinthian opinion at pp. 230–234 is not assigned and has not been briefed here. The full statutory text and comments remain a SEL source gap.
